title: QuasiLeak-Bench: Evaluating LLM-Based Privacy Detectors on Policy-Conditioned Quasi-Evidence Group Recovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.21333v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Natural language messages often contain quasi-identifiers that are weak in isolation but can jointly reveal an individual's private attributes. We call such a jointly revealing set of cues a quasi-evidence group. Existing privacy benchmarks focus on explicit identifiers, attribute inference, or task-driven disclosures, leaving inference from quasi-evidence groups largely unmeasured. In practice, whether exposing such a quasi-evidence group violates privacy also depends on sender-specified disclosure policies. We introduce QuasiLeak-Bench, a benchmark for policy-conditioned quasi-evidence group recovery, which evaluates whether detectors recover complete quasi-evidence groups and flag the disclosures the given policy prohibits. translated_title: QuasiLeak-Bench：基于策略条件的准证据组恢复来评估大语言模型隐私检测器
translated_abstract: 自然语言消息中通常包含准标识符，这些标识符单独来看信息较弱，但联合起来可以揭示个人的隐私属性。我们将这种能够联合揭示信息的线索集合称为“准证据组”。现有的隐私基准主要关注显式标识符、属性推断或任务驱动的披露行为，而对基于准证据组的隐私推断在很大程度上缺乏测量。在实际场景中，暴露此类准证据组是否构成隐私侵犯，还取决于发送方指定的披露策略。我们提出了QuasiLeak-Bench，一个面向策略条件下准证据组恢复的基准，用于评估检测器能否完整恢复准证据组，并标记出给定策略所禁止的披露内容。为了大规模获取可靠的真值标注，我们设计了反向构建流水线：首先筛选弱准标识符，将其组合为经验证可联合揭示目标属性的准证据组，并生成……
tldr: 提出QuasiLeak-Bench基准，用于评估大语言模型隐私检测器能否完整恢复联合揭示隐私属性的准证据组（弱准标识符组合），并依据发送方指定的披露策略标记违规泄露。
en_tdlr: QuasiLeak-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating LLM-based privacy detectors on recovering complete quasi-evidence groups—weak cues that jointly reveal private attributes—and flagging disclosures prohibited by sender-specified policies.
